$comment: Agent hardening for this repo. Every rule traces to an incident in
docs/AGENT-HARDENING.md or a standing constraint in CLAUDE.md.
One guard script sees every Bash call rather than relying on the per-hook
'if' matcher: 'if' does best-effort bash parsing and fails OPEN on parse
failure, which is the one behaviour we cannot accept here.
Read-only inspection (systemctl status, journalctl, git status/diff/log,
ssh, curl, sqlite3 ?mode=ro) is deliberately untouched -- the agents on
this project must reach the real cluster.
